title: System Security Engineering Data Schema
description: A schema for managing the application of security controls and overlays to specific systems.

systemOverlay.description: Associates a security control overlay with a specific system and defines its applicability.

system.description: Reference to the system to which the overlay applies.

overlayId.description: A reference to the UUID of the security control overlay being applied.

applicability.description: Indicates if the overlay is applicable to this system. If not applicable, provides the reasoning.

applicable.description: True if the overlay is relevant for this system; false if not applicable.

reasoning.description: If 'applicable' is false, this field provides the rationale or justification for non-applicability.

systemSecurityControl.description: Associates a security control with a particular system, hardware, or software, capturing applicability, compliance, and tailored implementation to support system-specific security assessments.

component.description: Reference to the system, hardware, or software to which this control applies.

controlId.description: A reference to the UUID of the security control being evaluated for this system; can reference standard or custom controls.

applicability.description: Indicates if the control is applicable to this system. If not applicable, provides the reasoning.

applicable.description: True if the control is relevant and should be implemented for this system; false if not applicable.

reasoning.description: Explaination of why the control is applicable or not applicable to the given system.

compliant.description: A flag denoting if the system meets the requirements of this control, used for compliance reporting.

implementationStatus.description: The current state of the control's implementation on the system.

discussion.description: Narrative details on how the control is implemented, any deviations, compensating measures, or reasons for non-applicability/compliance.

systemOverlays.description: A list of associations between systems and security control overlays.

systemSecurityControls.description: An array tracking the application of security controls to specific systems, including compliance status and implementation details, for system-level risk management and auditing.
